lemma.statement: For W the n=1 annulus-twist trace with Q_W = [[2,1],[1,0]], C = K_0 x I the trace annulus and p: W_2 -> W the oriented double branched cover, b2+(W_2) >= 1 and b2-(W_2) >= 1; hence for any P glued to either boundary component along a rational homology sphere, Q_{P u W_2} = Q_P (+) Q_{W_2} over Q and P u W_2 is indefinite in either orientation.

hypotheses_checked.cobordism_is_genuinely_W2: yes: lk(K_0,c'_i)=0 and C disjoint from the attaching circles, so each handle lifts to two handles and the branched covering extends across those exact handles; W_2 = (Y_0 x I) u (four lifted 2-handles)
hypotheses_checked.relative_cohomology_applies_to_both_boun: yes: dW = S^3 u S^3 and dW_2 = (-Y_0) u Y_1 are rational homology spheres, so H^1(d;Q)=H^2(d;Q)=0 and H^2(.,d;Q) -> H^2(.;Q) is an isomorphism on both
hypotheses_checked.degree_and_orientation_conventions: p proper of degree 2, p(dW_2) in dW, p_*[W_2,dW_2] = 2[W,dW]; cup product naturality holds for any continuous map and the branch locus is codimension 2
hypotheses_checked.rational_direct_sum_for_the_gluing: yes: H_2(Y;Q)=H_1(Y;Q)=0 gives 0 -> H_2(P;Q)(+)H_2(W_2;Q) -> H_2(P u W_2;Q) -> 0 with the pieces orthogonal
hypotheses_checked.actual_trace_not_an_arbitrary_filling: the lemma is proved about W_2 defined by the branched cover, not about any filling matched only on the boundary; whether the bounded slope search of research/34 section 5 found the covering-induced slopes was NOT established and is not needed

lemma.independent_cross_check: G-signature: sigma(W_2) = 2 sigma(W) - [C]^2/2 = 0 since sigma(W)=0 and [C]^2=0; with b2(W_2) >= 2 this forces indefiniteness independently

excluded: capping the branched trace W_2 with the negative definite plumbing P(-3,-3,-2) to obtain a rank-seven negative definite filling of Sigma_2(K_1); handle slides preserve the form and negative blow-ups only add <-1> summands
NOT_excluded: other non-trace negative definite fillings of Y_1

what_it_does_NOT_give: Y_1 bounds a rational homology ball

correct_donaldson_statement.closed_manifold_if_supplied: (P natural-sum X_1) glued to -Z along Y_0 # (-Y_1), closed smooth oriented negative definite, b_2 = 3 + b_2(X_1)
correct_donaldson_statement.theorem_invoked: Donaldson diagonalizability for closed smooth oriented negative definite 4-manifolds
